confidence_notes: Restaurant, coffee, and draft-beer anchors use Interlaken's May 2026 Numbeo averages; cocktail and wine estimates use local 2026 guide ranges. Accommodation is a holistic estimate with strong seasonal variation, not live listing data.
comparable_city_reasoning: Food and drink use direct Interlaken prices; accommodation is estimated from the Swiss alpine tourist-town context of the Bernese Oberland, comparable to Grindelwald and Lauterbrunnen.
